patterns.note: The hero section dramatically transitions from a dark, text-focused overlay to a vibrant, full-bleed landscape image with a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls down.

The primary navigation bar transforms its appearance and stickiness: initially dark and opaque, then transparent over the hero, and finally a solid white bar with a subtle shadow when sticky at the top.
Key information is presented in asymmetrical text blocks, often with a large, bold heading paired with smaller, legible body text, creating a clear visual hierarchy and modern feel.

A high-contrast palette of black, white, and light gray is consistently used, punctuated by vibrant, gradient-like accent colors (pink, purple, blue) for subtle background elements and brand highlights.
Monospaced, uppercase labels are employed for section identifiers and metadata, providing a structured and technical counterpoint to the primary sans-serif headings and body text.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video-hero background that is initially obscured by a dark, semi-transparent overlay. As the user scrolls, the overlay lifts or fades, revealing the full-bleed video content underneath with a subtle parallax movement, while the text elements remain fixed relative to the viewport.

The global navigation bar dynamically changes its background, opacity, and shadow based on the user's scroll position, transitioning from an initial dark state to a transparent overlay over the hero, and then becoming a sticky, solid white bar with a soft drop shadow after the hero section is scrolled past.
Large brand elements, such as the company logo, are used as semi-transparent background graphics in the footer, revealing progressively as the user scrolls to the bottom of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with legible body text and distinct, smaller uppercase monospaced labels, creating a modern and structured hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; elements like buttons and content blocks feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between sections and within text blocks contributes to a clean, open layout.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic hero section, which dramatically transforms from a dark, text-focused overlay to a vibrant, full-bleed landscape image with a parallax effect upon scrolling. This, combined with the large, semi-transparent brand logo used as a background element in the footer, creates a memorable and sophisticated visual experience.
